details.description: Dark rounded rectangular face bezel with soft bevel encasing screen
Glowing white cat eyes with vertical slit pupils on black screen
Minimalist white caret '^' mouth below cat eyes
Left triangular cat ear with pink satin body shell, pointed tip
Right triangular cat ear mirror of left with pink body
Hot-pink emissive inner triangular pads inside cat ears #FF2A85 intensity 2.2
Thick arching overhead headband connecting earcups, pink satin with center seam
Left oversized cylindrical side earcup with silver outer rim
Right oversized earcup mirror with silver rim
Glowing pink center hexagon logo badges on side earcups with inner ring
Concentric glowing pink chest subwoofer ring #FF2A85 emissiveIntensity 2.2 around black speaker
Black speaker cone with central dome and perforated fabric mesh
Twin circular silver metallic headlight/knobs flanking chest speaker
Two lower rectangular silver speaker grilles on front bumper with horizontal slats
Tactical walkie-talkie radio receiver module on right side panel, dark gray
Small toggle switches and knobs on radio module side
Dual vertical whip antennas with ball tips on radio module top
Four wide black rubber tires #1C1C1E roughness 0.85 with deep tread
Silver 6-spoke star rims #D1D5DB metalness 0.85 roughness 0.22 with lug nuts
Layered circular pink and white stage display disc with 5 concentric rings beneath wheels
Satin pastel pink plastic body #EE98B9 with clearcoat 0.2 satin sheen and panel seams
Small pink emissive accent strips along side panels and fenders
